purpose: Clean installation on VPS for UI evaluation and screenshots

commands: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y
sudo apt install -y nginx php8.3-fpm php8.3-cli php8.3-mysql php8.3-mbstring php8.3-xml php8.3-curl php8.3-zip php8.3-gd composer mysql-server git unzip
sudo mysql -e "CREATE DATABASE krayin; CREATE USER 'krayin'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'strong_password'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON krayin.* TO 'krayin'@'localhost'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
nano .env  # Set APP_URL=http://your-vps-ip-or-domain, DB_DATABASE=krayin, DB_USERNAME=krayin, DB_PASSWORD=strong_password, MAIL settings

# root /var/www/laravel-crm/public; index index.php; location / { try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$query_string; } location ~ \.php$ { include snippets/fastcgi-php.conf; fastcgi_pass unix:/run/php/php8.3-fpm.sock; }
sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx

docker_alternative.description: For faster clean setup without manual config
steps: # Edit docker-compose.yml for ports and volumes

notes_for_ui_evaluation: After install, explore Dashboard, Leads, Contacts, Products, Sales, Settings modules.
Check if multi-tenant or group admin features meet needs.
Test responsiveness and screenshots of key screens.
For production, run 'composer install --no-dev' and configure SSL.
